name: ask
description: 向独立验证器询问掩码组件是否符合任务变化要求。
source_description: Ask the independent verifier about building change in mask components. With no arguments it checks the components of your current answer that have no answer yet, largest first, up to 64 per call; remaining_unverified says how many are left. For a mask without ids, the same on that mask. With ids it asks about exactly those components, up to 64 in total. Returns answer, type, reason, p_yes (relative yes/no reading, may be null), status. Unparsed is not no.
output: 逐组件 answer、type、reason、p_yes、status；剩余未核验数
backend: 可配置验证器；CLI 默认 qwen3.7-plus，G3/G4 本批轨迹用 qwen3.7-flash；也支持本地验证器
tasks: T1 / T3 / T4 / T5；实际取决于会话输入与开关，代码未定义逐任务白名单
rules: G4：此工具不直接产生最新 mask 提醒。
G3：自动选择仅包含反馈点半径 32 像素/方位格内或被编辑的相关组件；显式 ids 不经过此筛选。每次最多 64 个组件，无法解析不等于 no。

Proposal handles props#k use the same operations as inst#k; select by ids or where="score >= threshold", then to_mask(sets=[handle]).

name: submit

rules: G4：此工具不直接产生最新 mask 提醒。
开启 --verify-stage：首次提交及尚欠核验组件会被拦下，返回报告；答案是证据，规划器决定是否修改。G2/G3 预算报告给出复核机会；异常或预算耗尽仍会兜底。
G3：报告区域外像素及已核验的反向类型；方向只报告。
G4：有 region#0 时在实际提交处求交，保存前后句柄及删除像素数；显式提交与兜底都适用。

name: python
description: 在隔离子进程中对只读数组做运算并保存新掩码。
source_description: Run array calculations in an isolated Python subprocess with np and ndi. Inputs: masks[handle] (H,W bool), instances[handle] (N,H,W bool, only for handles written out in the code), images["t1"/"t2"] (H,W,3 uint8), all read-only. Call save_mask(array) for each output mask. No filesystem, network or submission access. New handles become usable in the next reply; submit them with submit. By default the returned mask becomes your current answer; pass set_current=false for intermediate candidates.
output: 零个或多个 mask#k、标准输出文字及统计

declaration.help: Offer the isolated Python array tool.
